description: Distractor: axios calls carry no per-call timeout but the client sets one at creation, the per-SKU loop only reads an in-memory Map built from one batched request, the reservation Map is swept by TTL, and the sweep interval is cleared in stop()

hard.note: Call sites look timeout-less and a loop sits after an HTTP call, but the timeout is client-level and the loop does no I/O; the Map has TTL eviction

_calibration.note: Clean fixture: any finding is a false positive. Deleting Map entries during for..of iteration verified safe on Node (size drops to 0).
